items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Perry Como, kept me on his show... I've recorded Perry Como

ctx.x: Now, you also began to do a lot of studio work, too, in that period, didn't you?
Quite a lot. Very much. Making records for all the big names that's even today -- Sammy Davis, just keep naming, Perry Como, kept me on his show.
Oh, you worked his television show, too, didn't you?
